description: This PHP source file defines the 'CallsViewEdit' class, extending 'ViewEdit', handling the editing view for call records in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for pre-display setup and rendering the display, involving JSON configuration and reminders data management.

classes.name: CallsViewEdit
classes.description: A view class for editing call records in SuiteCRM, managing display and pre-display logic, and integrating JSON configuration and reminders data.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the call record before rendering, setting the status based on request parameters.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the display logic for the call edit view, including loading JSON configurations and reminders data, and passing them to the template.
